channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Guy Lewis | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Guy Lewis from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Elvin Hayes on Guy Lewis
item.description:
Mark Berman:Elvin Hayes:

“All the awards I've received, Hall of Fame, NBA Championships, NBA 50 Greatest, Guy Lewis is a part of all of that.”

Elvin Hayes on Guy Lewis, Nov 26, 2015. Source: Twitter @MarkBermanFox26.

item.title: Elvin Hayes on Guy Lewis
item.description:
Mark Berman:Elvin Hayes on passing of Guy Lewis:

“I don't think he realized the accomplishments which he achieved by opening the doors to black athletes”

Elvin Hayes on Guy Lewis, Nov 26, 2015. Source: Twitter @MarkBermanFox26.

item.title: Elvin Hayes on Guy Lewis
item.description:
Mark Berman:Elvin Hayes on passing of Guy Lewis:

“I told Terry his son this morning, I said thank u & I thank your dad for the love he gave all of us.”

Elvin Hayes on Guy Lewis, Nov 26, 2015. Source: Twitter @MarkBermanFox26.

item.title: Elvin Hayes on Guy Lewis
item.description:
Mark Berman:Elvin Hayes on passing of Guy Lewis:

“My daughter told me if it wasn't for Guy Lewis we wouldn't be here today & that is so true”

Elvin Hayes on Guy Lewis, Nov 26, 2015. Source: Twitter @MarkBermanFox26.

item.title: Elvin Hayes on Guy Lewis
item.description:
Elvin Hayes on passing of Guy Lewis:

“We miss him but I know he's much better off. I can see him running around coaching a great team up there. That kid to the University of Houston in a time of integration & put his career on the line & gave me an opportunity to achieve & accomplish all that I'm accomplishing today. It's all due to Guy Lewis.”

Elvin Hayes on Guy Lewis, Nov 26, 2015. Source: Twitter @MarkBermanFox26.

item.title: Elvin Hayes on Guy Lewis, Don Chaney
item.description:
“Here's a man who took a little kid out of Rayville, La., put his career and everything on the line, to bring (former UH star) Don Chaney and I in there to give us an opportunity to showcase our talent and our ability, to mold us and grow us and give us a true start in life. Now to have the opportunity to stand before all of the great players and coaches that played this game, to present my coach Guy V. Lewis, words can never express what this means to me. I'm appreciative to have this opportunity to introduce him into the Basketball Hall of Fame.”

Elvin Hayes on Guy Lewis, Don Chaney, Aug 7, 2013. Source: FOX 26 Sports.

item.title: Elvin Hayes on Guy Lewis
item.description:
“To be able to be a presenter for Guy Lewis at the Basketball Hall of Fame, it probably means just as much as when I was inducted into the Hall of Fame,”

Elvin Hayes on Guy Lewis, Aug 7, 2013. Source: FOX 26 Sports.

item.title: Clyde Drexler on Hakeem Olajuwon, Elvin Hayes, Guy Lewis
item.description:
Mark Berman:Drexler on Guy Lewis:

“He's more deserving than Elvin Hayes, Hakeem Olajuwon & myself. He helped mold us into the players that we became.”

Clyde Drexler on Hakeem Olajuwon, Elvin Hayes, Guy Lewis, Feb 15, 2013. Source: Twitter @MarkBermanFox26.
